headline: Clean little ESE prime swell — dawn patrol reward.
today: Prime ESE angle with a longer-period component sneaking in and light WNW offshore at dawn before the N cross builds. It's only waist-high, but the early glass is legit — grab the log or fish and be in by first light around the outgoing tide. Once the cross fills in mid-morning it goes sideways and dull.

daysToWatch.note: Best day on the board here: near 2ft E at prime angle, decent period, and light cross-off to glassy-light winds. Worth the drive for a fun small day — fish or groveler.
Swell fades and SW wind builds through the day — junky and getting worse.
Size shows up (2.5ft-plus) with offshore WNW wind, but it's a poor S angle — wrong direction, so expect it to be lumpy and closed-out despite the wind. Manage expectations.
